blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— Rather than viewing recognition as a measure of personal success, FPJ Panday Bayanihan Party-List Rep. Brian Poe sees it as a renewed responsibility to work harder and remain worthy of the Filipino people’s trust. Poe delivered that message on Thursday as he accepted the award for the Top Performing, Most Trusted Party-List in the Philippines at the Media People’s Choice Awards 2026 at Camp Aguinaldo, Quezon City. He said the recognition was especially meaningful for a neophyte legislator like him,, not only because it acknowledged his work in public service but also because it represented the collective efforts of […]...
